bug_semantics: The smart_user MCP tool accepts a caller-controlled username for operation get-user-info and passes it unchanged through SmartUser.run() -> getUserInfo() -> getUserDetails(). On Unix, getUserDetails() interpolated that value into the shell command string `getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:" /etc/passwd`, which promisified child_process.exec executed through a shell. POSIX command substitution remains active inside double quotes, so a username such as `$(id > /tmp/marker)` executes as the MCP server user before getent or grep processes the argument.
flaw_origin: Commit fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff added src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts as a new file during the hypercontext-tool integration, including both the unrestricted username schema and the execAsync shell interpolation at line 918. Commit 093bdbfe3c656356af48b03a970108d0460ee551 later registered SMART_USER_TOOL_DEFINITION and the smart_user dispatcher in src/server/index.ts, making the latent sink MCP-callable; the first semantic-version tag containing that registration is v2.5.0. Formatting commit 3638681fe49211777bbd362b4ec88a5e3aa24b24 only removed a trailing comma and did not create the vulnerable expression.
ai_marker: BIC commit object fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff has human author and committer `franklinic <franklin@ivorycloud.com>` and the exact disclosure line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`; it has no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with trailer. No AI evidence from the later registration or fix commits was used for the verdict.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-49mq-fc6q-3h46 / CVE-2026-55157 identifies @ooples/token-optimizer-mcp <5.1.0 as vulnerable and 5.1.0 as first patched, gives the exact getent/grep command, and demonstrates shell command substitution through smart_user/get-user-info/username.

`git log --all --reverse -S'getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:" /etc/passwd' --` first reports fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff, then direct fix 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326 and landed fix b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 as removals. Restricting the search to src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts gives the same lifecycle.

`git log -L 917,919:src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts 4ae7c351659b3a1a7f741f6dc427577aead9fdd8` shows fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff adding the three-line execAsync call from /dev/null and 3638681fe49211777bbd362b4ec88a5e3aa24b24 later changing only its trailing comma. `git blame -L 910,925 4ae7c351659b3a1a7f741f6dc427577aead9fdd8` likewise traces the call and surrounding logic back to fc358, apart from formatting-only lines.

Direct parent verification: `git cat-file -e fd39560c09415bd9b81d48f8cf9fe40f38e5b417:src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts` fails because the file does not exist, and `git grep -F 'getent passwd "${username}" || grep "^${username}:" /etc/passwd' fd39560c09415bd9b81d48f8cf9fe40f38e5b417 --` returns no match anywhere in the parent tree.

At fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff, src/tools/system-operations/smart-user.ts lines 199-200 dispatch operation get-user-info to getUserInfo; lines 371-405 require but do not validate options.username and pass it to getUserDetails; lines 918-919 interpolate it into execAsync; lines 1498-1522 expose username as an unrestricted string in SMART_USER_TOOL_DEFINITION.

`git log --reverse -S'SMART_USER_TOOL_DEFINITION' -- src/server/index.ts` identifies 093bdbfe3c656356af48b03a970108d0460ee551 as the registration commit. `git grep -E 'SMART_USER_TOOL_DEFINITION|smart_user|smartUser\.run' v2.4.1 v2.5.0 -- src/server/index.ts` finds no exposure in v2.4.1 but finds the definition, case, and run call in v2.5.0, establishing the MCP reachability boundary even though the advisory expresses the package range broadly as <5.1.0.

The closing boundary is direct: b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 has parent 4ae7c351659b3a1a7f741f6dc427577aead9fdd8; `git grep -F` finds the vulnerable command at parent line 918, while the b4ee patch replaces child_process.exec/promisify and the shell string with lookupPasswdEntry(), assertSafeArg(), in-process /etc/passwd fallback, and execFileSafe('getent', ['passwd', username]).

The advisory-linked b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 is the landed squash commit. Preserved PR member 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326 is the earliest direct patch: its parent f5c19c69d936aa8a2c9d736825bb31eefaacf5d6 still contains the exact shell string and 0efa does not. Therefore fix_sha records the landed advisory commit and direct_fix_sha records the source commit that directly removed this sink.

`git tag --contains b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7 --sort=version:refname` starts at v5.1.0. Tag v5.0.1 (commit 8138f3a6d32eff80387f24d6068039ae8fb7bfa9) contains the vulnerable command at smart-user.ts:918; tag v5.1.0 (commit 94815a16e3322101694e97561fc1dc8b5af904dc) does not and instead contains lookupPasswdEntry plus execFileSafe argv-mode calls. This independently matches the advisory's <5.1.0 / 5.1.0 boundary.

`git cat-file -p fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff` directly reproduces the BIC-only AI signal: the commit message ends with `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`. The commit has exactly one parent and is not a squash merge; no smaller in-repository member commit precedes its addition of the new smart-user file, so squash_decomposed is false and decomposed_shas is empty.
reasoning: The vulnerability is caused by constructing a shell command from an unvalidated MCP username and executing it with child_process.exec. Git -S and -L agree that fc3582544f6df4a14dcd3015edc835780f746aff is the smallest target-repository commit that first wrote the vulnerable sink and its data-flow scaffolding; its direct parent lacks both the file and the command. The later formatter is not causal, and the later registration commit activates rather than originates the flawed code. The BIC commit object explicitly says it was generated with Claude Code, so under the BIC-only evidence rule the AI authored the root-causing code, yielding AI_ROOT_CAUSE. The official landed fix is b4ee96dac799cbfba0a9f9c17844ce9d613cbcc7, whose direct PR source commit is 0efa1956670b689911dfb3fddd08e7b6fc099326; v5.0.1 is demonstrably vulnerable and v5.1.0 contains the argv-mode fix.
